emails_birthday_body: In case you forgot, today is your birthday! We hope you have a great day and all of your birthday wishes come true.
emails_holidays_body: We hope you have a great holiday season! 🎅
emails_comment_body_owner: {#strong}{commenter}{/strong} has left a comment on one of your items ({#link}{itemTitle}{/link}).
emails_comment_body_mention: {#strong}{commenter}{/strong} mentioned you in a comment on an item ({#link}{itemTitle}{/link}).
emails_orphan_subject: An item you claimed for {recipientName} was removed
emails_orphan_heading: An item you claimed was removed
emails_orphan_body_named: {#strong}{recipientName}{/strong} removed {#em}{itemTitle}{/em} from {#strong}{listName}{/strong}. You (or your partner) had already claimed it. They were never told you claimed it, so they don't know that you may have already purchased the gift.
emails_orphan_body_anon: The recipient removed {#em}{itemTitle}{/em} from {#strong}{listName}{/strong}. You (or your partner) had already claimed it. They were never told you claimed it, so they don't know that you may have already purchased the gift.
emails_orphan_next: You may want to return the item, hold onto it for another occasion, or give it anyway. Once you've decided, head into the app to acknowledge the alert and clear the item from your view.
emails_cleanup_subject: Cleaning up an unanswered claim tomorrow
emails_cleanup_body_named: {#strong}{recipientName}{/strong} removed {#em}{itemTitle}{/em} from {#strong}{listName}{/strong} a while back, and you haven't acknowledged it yet. Tomorrow{event}, {appTitle} will automatically clear the claim from your view to keep things tidy.
emails_cleanup_body_anon: The recipient removed {#em}{itemTitle}{/em} from {#strong}{listName}{/strong} a while back, and you haven't acknowledged it yet. Tomorrow{event}, {appTitle} will automatically clear the claim from your view to keep things tidy.
emails_cleanup_next: If you'd like to acknowledge it manually first, or just want to confirm what you bought, use the button below.
emails_parents_body: You’ve tagged {names} for {holidayName}. Take a peek at their {#link}lists{/link} if you’re still looking for something.

match.countPlural=one: Your anniversary with {partnerName} is in {leadDays} day
match.countPlural=*: Your anniversary with {partnerName} is in {leadDays} days

emails_anniversary_body: {name}, your anniversary with {partnerName} is coming up. Take a look at their list at {#link}All Lists{/link}.
emails_valentines_body: {name}, Valentine's Day is coming up. Check what {partnerName} has on their list at {#link}All Lists{/link}.
emails_pre_birthday_body: Now is a good time to make sure your birthday list doesn't suck. Add or remove items, set priorities, and update anything that's gone stale on your {#link}My Lists{/link} page.
emails_pre_christmas_body: Time to spruce up your Christmas list. Add anything new, drop what you've outgrown, and make it easier for the people shopping for you. Head to {#link}My Lists{/link} to review.
emails_pre_holiday_body: {name}, if you've got plans for {holidayName} this year, now is a good time to make a list. Head to {#link}My Lists{/link} to create one.

match.countPlural=one: Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset the password on your {appTitle} account. Click the button below to choose a new password. The link is good for {expiresInMinutes} minute.
match.countPlural=*: Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset the password on your {appTitle} account. Click the button below to choose a new password. The link is good for {expiresInMinutes} minutes.

emails_reset_paste: If the button doesn't work, paste this URL into your browser:
emails_reset_ignore: If you didn't request a password reset you can safely ignore this email. Your password won't change.
emails_reveal_footer: These gifts have been archived and can be found on your {#link}Received Gifts{/link} page.
emails_reveal_subject_generic: A look back at your gifts
emails_reveal_intro_birthday_self: We hope you had a wonderful birthday. Here's who gave you what.
emails_reveal_intro_birthday_dependent: We hope {name} had a wonderful birthday. Here's who gave {name} what.
emails_reveal_subject_occasion_self: A look back at your {occasion} gifts
emails_reveal_intro_occasion_self: We hope your {occasion} was wonderful. Here's who gave you what.
emails_reveal_intro_occasion_dependent: We hope {name}'s {occasion} was wonderful. Here's who gave {name} what.
